turns.assessment: The optical layers on both constituent lightpaths remained stable in power, OSNR, BER, DGD and SOP, ruling strongly against line-interface, span, amplifier and ROADM optical faults. Only svc361 failed while the other services through S09, S15 and S05 remained operational, ruling against a switch-fabric-wide failure. The paired ODU_TIM alarms at both service ends are characteristic of this ODU being misrouted at the intermediate OTN cross-connect joining its two lightpaths, most likely at S15.

proposals.rationale: S15 joins svc361's two lightpaths. A service-specific cross-connect misconnection there explains bidirectional ODU trace mismatch and client failure with entirely normal optical measurements and unaffected neighboring ODUs.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment

proposals.rationale: An endpoint ODU cross-connect error could also misroute only svc361 without optical changes, but the intermediate junction at S15 is the more natural common point for the two-lightpath service.

proposals.rationale: An endpoint ODU cross-connect error at S05 remains possible but is less consistent than a fault at the lightpath interconnection in S15.
